extensionDescription.message: Private notes per website or page, with movable sticky notes and local backups.

restrictedHelp.message: Open a regular http(s) website to create notes. Firefox system pages and Mozilla add-on pages are restricted.

stickyUnavailable.message: Firefox does not allow sticky notes on this page. Try a regular website.

privacyMessage.message: All notes stay on this device. No account, no tracking, no syncing.

backupWarning.message: Tip: make regular JSON backups. Removing the add-on deletes local notes.

noNotes.message: No notes found. Open a website and write your first note!

confirmImport.message: Import notes? Existing notes for the same site or page will be overwritten.

stickyFailed.message: Could not open the sticky note.

autoShowForSite.message: Automatically show sticky notes on this website

autoPermissionDenied.message: Permission denied. Automatic sticky notes remain disabled.

autoSetFailed.message: Could not configure automatic sticky notes.

permissionIntro.message: Automatically show sticky notes on this website

permissionExplanation.message: To restore your note automatically after a refresh, Spiderpiggy Website Notes needs access to this website. Firefox asks only once while you keep the permission.

permissionOnlyThisSite.message: This website only. Your notes stay on your device.

permissionGrant.message: Grant access and return to website

permissionSuccess.message: Permission granted! Automatic sticky notes are now enabled.

permissionDeclined.message: Access was not granted. You can still use the regular popup.

permissionError.message: Could not set up site access.

permissionInvalid.message: The website could not be verified. Open the add-on from the desired website again.

permissionCompleted.message: You may close this tab and return to the website.

permissionFirstHint.message: For automatic display, Firefox opens a separate one-time permission page so its prompt remains visible.

allSitesSettingInfo.message: Optional. Grant access to normal websites in one step. Automatic sticky notes remain configurable per website. Firefox system pages remain excluded.

confirmRevokeAllSites.message: Revoke broad website access? Any permissions granted separately for individual websites may remain.

allSitesLabel.message: All regular HTTP and HTTPS websites

allSitesPermissionExplain.message: With this optional permission, Firefox does not need to ask again for each website. This applies to normal HTTP and HTTPS websites; restricted Firefox pages are excluded.

allSitesPermissionDetail.message: Automatic sticky notes remain optional for each website. Notes stay on your device. You can revoke this permission from Settings later.

allSitesSuccess.message: All-sites permission granted. You can close this tab and use the extension.
